summary: search_text now runs exactly one `rg --json` per call over the target path (flags from options: --glob, --hidden, --no-ignore, --max-depth 64, --max-filesize 1MiB, --context, --ignore-case, --fixed-strings only for literal=true/regex=false, plus --binary/--sort path/--max-count). Query is a regex by default; new `literal` option. Events are streamed and the child is killed once max_matches matches plus their trailing context are collected. Pipe byte cap, truncation reasons and per-result safety (checked_result_path, search-root containment, canonical workspace containment, regular-file check, private output inode skip, binary end-event handling, 2 KiB line cap) are kept. Removed the 256-file listing, 16-file batches, MAX_FILES/FILES_PER_CHILD/MAX_SEARCH_CHUNKS and search_requires_subprocess. The in-process scan is only a literal fallback when ripgrep is unavailable (or under a worker gate, which cannot confine rg). search_process_budget(search_text)=1. The tool description, schema and system_prompt snippet now say regex by default.
